name: Eseoghene Awhatorhe
bio: THRIVE Initiative was founded on the belief that Africa's youth, women, and children are powerful agents of change, and by investing in their growth, we contribute to a more inclusive, educated, and sustainable future.

name: Awhatorhe Damilola
bio: We hope to give people the opportunities they lack. As the popular saying goes, it is best to teach a man how to fish rather than just giving them the fish. This is one way we can help people in the community.

name: Aisha Abdulaziz
bio: I really connect with the idea of empowering people and building inclusion, creating spaces where people grow together. Excited to learn, contribute, and be part of this movement.

name: Ogenemene Okpukpu Jerry
role: Director of Women Empowerment & Gender Programs
bio: I am a firm believer in gender equity and equality and also in children's education. Joining THRIVE gives me an opportunity to advocate for these beliefs.

name: Kuatsea Shagbaor Joseph
role: Director of Advocacy, Policy and Social Inclusion
bio: I am intentional about making a difference in the society, especially among women and children who have been underrepresented.

name: Saramo Gesi-ere Eneruvie
role: Director of Volunteers and Membership Engagement
bio: I would love to help women and children in underserved communities.

name: Ademola Favour Tofunmi
bio: I am interested in THRIVE because I love making impacts, no matter how little, in the lives of persons I come in contact with.

name: Opara David Robert
role: Director of Communication and Public Relations
bio: I look forward to solving the problem of bringing opportunities, encouragement, and exposure to the younger generation, particularly in skill development and capacity building.

name: Safeeyarh
role: Director of Communication and Public Relations
bio: THRIVE is an opportunity to do more than talk about these issues. It is a chance to learn, contribute, and be part of creating a community where women and children are seen, heard, supported, and empowered.

name: Omobolaji Durojaiye
bio: THRIVE Initiative gives us the chance to use our voices and skills for something bigger than us which is telling the story of Africa's women, children, and youth in ways that inspire action. I believe that when more people can see this work, more doors open for people who deserve to be seen, heard, and supported.
